name: qabit-task-manager
description: Gestor de tareas: API NestJS (hexagonal) + web Next.js + contrato compartido con Zod

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && npm run db:migrate -w @task-manager/api && concurrently -k -n shared,api,web -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev -w @task-manager/shared" "npm run dev -w @task-manager/api" "npm run dev -w @task-manager/web"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @task-manager/api && npm run build -w @task-manager/web
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n api,web -c green,magenta "npm run start -w @task-manager/api" "npm run start -w @task-manager/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
